1. The service

NUR provides Islamic reference tools for personal worship and learning: prayer times and reminders, Qiblah direction, Quran reading and recitation, hadith, duas and adhkar, a tasbeeh counter, a prayer tracker, an Islamic calendar, scholar quotes, daily inspiration and a Zakat calculator. NUR is free and does not require an account.

2. Accuracy

Prayer times are calculated on your device from your location and the calculation method you choose. They are approximations and may differ from the times announced by your local masjid. Please confirm important times with your community.

Qiblah direction relies on your phone's location and compass, which can be affected by calibration and magnetic interference.

Hijri dates follow the Umm al-Qura calendar and may differ by a day from local moon sighting. You can adjust them in Settings.

The Zakat calculator applies commonly used rules and live metal prices as a guide. It is not a religious ruling. For your specific situation, consult a qualified scholar.

Religious content (Quran text, translations, hadith, duas and scholar quotes) comes from established published sources. NUR does not issue religious rulings (fatwas) and is not a substitute for scholarly guidance.
